description: Angular component for a details panel in the Thingsboard UI, managing display and editing of details with search and toggle features.

classes.name: DetailsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending PageComponent, providing a configurable details panel with editing and search capabilities.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from form value changes and calls superclass cleanup.

methods.name: onCloseDetails
methods.description: Emits event to close the details panel.

methods.name: onToggleDetailsEditMode
methods.description: Toggles edit mode if not always editable and emits the toggle event.

methods.name: onApplyDetails
methods.description: Emits apply event if form is valid.

methods.name: onToggleSearch
methods.description: Toggles search pane visibility and emits close event if search is hidden.
